description: A 16-step drum sequencer with four trigger tracks: each step's knob is a number whose binary digits say which of the four tracks fire.

params.text: Sets which tracks that step fires, 0 to 15: 1 is track 1, 2 is track 2, 4 is track 3, 8 is track 4, and any sum of those fires all of them; 0 fires nothing and 15 fires all four.
Chooses the pattern, 1 to 16; changing it loads that pattern into the sixteen step knobs.
Sets how many of the sixteen steps are played before the sequence wraps, 1 to 16.
Adds extra triggers on rhythmically likely steps for the length of one measure, without changing the stored pattern.
Sets which tracks the mutation may add to, 0 to 15, read the same way a step knob is; the four lamps beside it show the choice.

inputs.text: A rising edge past 2V moves the sequence on one step and fires whichever tracks that step names.
A rising edge past 2V puts the sequence back before its first step and restores the pattern from its stored version, dropping any mutation.
Takes over the pattern knob while a cable is here: 0V to 10V spans the 16 patterns, and the knob is moved to follow.

outputs.text: A 10V trigger 1ms long on every step whose value includes track 1.
A 10V trigger 1ms long on every step whose value includes track 2.
A 10V trigger 1ms long on every step whose value includes track 3.
A 10V trigger 1ms long on every step whose value includes track 4.

notes: Nothing moves until triggers arrive at STEP. The module has no clock of its own.
Turning the pattern knob overwrites the step knobs with that pattern, and moving a step knob writes back into the stored pattern, replacing the factory groove until the menu restores it.
All sixteen patterns are saved with the patch, edits included.
menu: Shift Pattern: Shift Right, Shift Left — moves every step of the current pattern one place around the sixteen.
Mutation Frequency: 1:1, 1:2, 1:3, 1:4 — sets how often a mutation is rolled: every measure, every second, every third or every fourth.
Clear Current Pattern — sets every step of the current pattern to 0.
Clear All Patterns — sets every step of all sixteen patterns to 0.
Reset to Factory Patterns — replaces all sixteen patterns with the grooves the module ships with, losing any edits.
